title: PLAC8 is an innovative biomarker for immunotherapy participating in remodeling the immune microenvironment of renal clear cell carcinoma.
summary: TCGA expression analyses and external cohort support PLAC8 immune associations; cell-line knockdown tested proliferation, migration and invasion. Immune-therapy response is computationally inferred, not demonstrated in a treated cohort. AI role: Machine-learning prognostic model based on PLAC8-related molecules. The article appeared in Frontiers In Oncology.
